name: Zentrum fuer Nanotechnologie und Nanomaterialien / TUM 5115

identity.qualification: Identity inferred from footprint agreement and official address, not an official identifier crosswalk.

references.observations: Three laboratory levels and a recessed entrance toward the common square.

Engineering photographs show pale panel bands, three glazed tiers, projecting horizontal shading rails, dark rooftop plant cladding and an ochre opaque area on the south end. Used for observation only; photographs are not packaged.

North face4 has glazing on all three levels; south face10 has an opaque lower zone. Together with the long east face3, this supports interpreting the engineering photograph as a southeast view. Orientation and dimensions remain inferred.

qualification: BVV survey fixes the envelope and stepped roof; facade opening dimensions, rail profiles, materials, entrance detail and south opaque panel dimensions are estimates. No interiors; no reference photographs or private projected pixels redistributed.
